name: harness
description: Harness Engineering — solo-dev product scaffolding. First run: harness:install onboards interactively and writes L1 user-rules (~/.harness/user-rules.md). harness:cycle runs the problem-first pre-cycle gate, scaffolds cycle artifacts, and enforces WIP=1. Quality-floor (structural anti-degradation): bar-lock + independent review gate + cross-cycle ratchet. Self-contained — concept docs bundled.
